summary: Iteration 11 validation: PolarizadosYA cutting flow now supports granular per-part material + rollo selection with multi-rollo inventory deduction. (1) BACKEND new pytest test_iteration11_features.py = 4/4 PASS validating: (a) two parts on two different rollos -> response contains inventory_deduction.multi with 2 entries, each rollo deducted independently (1.5m + 1.0m from 50m start), 2 inventory_movements rows; (b) two parts on the SAME rollo -> meters SUMMED into ONE deduction (1.2 + 0.8 = 2.0m), single inventory_movement; (c) order.cutting_part_materials persists and is returned by GET /api/orders/{id} (OrderResponse exposes the field); (d) legacy aggregated mode (inventory_item_id without part_materials) STILL works -> sums all part_measurements meters and deducts from single rollo. (2) FULL REGRESSION: pytest iter8 + iter9 + iter10 + iter11 = 21/21 PASS in 22.12s. (3) FRONTEND verified via browser automation (corte role @ /cutting): 'Completar Corte' dialog opens, renders exactly 9 part-block-<id> entries with 9 part-measurement-<id> inputs, 9 part-material-<id> selects (ROLLO_TYPES with 13 options each), 9 part-rollo-<id> selects (initially disabled until material is chosen). Selecting material=spectra in part-material-panoramico correctly filtered part-rollo-panoramico to 14 spectra rollos showing 'INV-XXXXX · <nombre> (<metros>m)' label. Selecting a rollo rendered part-rollo-info-panoramico with text 'Spectra · INV-00018 · quedan 29.00m'. (4) Badge logic part-pct-<id>: code-reviewed L613-619 CuttingView.jsx; getPartPercentage(order, partId) looks up cutting_services[].part_percentages[partId]. The legacy ASD456 order with no part_percentages correctly showed 'sin %' label (badge not rendered). NOTE: a newly created order via /api/orders with part_percentages on a 'Polarizado 3M Crystalline' service did NOT appear in /api/cutting/pending even after being driven to en_corte status — server.py L2143 cutting_services filter list does not match this service name; this is a pre-existing issue, NOT introduced by iter11. ASD456 (Polarizado/Ultrasecure - Nanooptik) is the only order matching the filter.

minor.issue: Filter at server.py L2143 (cutting_services list at L2118) does not match service names like 'Polarizado 3M Crystalline'. New polarizado orders may not appear in cutting queue. Only orders with names containing tokens like 'ultrasecure'/'polarizado'/'ppf' (depending on the cutting_services list contents) are surfaced. Pre-existing — not iter11 scope, but blocks creating fresh test orders via the new check-in -> en_corte flow for E2E validation of the part-pct badge.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L2199-2209: CuttingCompleteRequest.part_materials is well-typed as Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] with backward-compat fields (inventory_item_id, meters_used) kept.
server.py L2281-2297: deductions_per_rollo aggregation is correct — uses {inv_id: meters} dict that sums on same key (covers 'two parts same rollo' case in a clean way).
server.py L2288: _meters_from_part_measurements({part_id: measurement}) is called per-part, ensuring each part's max-dimension/100 contribution is added to the matching rollo (not the full sum).
server.py L2340-2342: inventory_deduction returns single object for 1 rollo and {multi: [...]} for >1 — clear distinction for frontend.

server.py L300-302: OrderResponse correctly exposes cutting_part_materials field. Note: cutting_part_materials is updated EVEN IF deductions_per_rollo is empty (L2267), so the field always reflects the user's selection.
CuttingView.jsx L40-54: ROLLO_TYPES list is hardcoded — should ideally be derived from /api/inventory or a backend constant to avoid drift. Minor maintainability concern.

CuttingView.jsx L643: when material changes, the conditional reset for inventory_item_id uses `prev[part.id]?.inventory_item_id` correctly — but the reset finds existing match in `rollos` with `r.tipo_rollo === newTipo`; since the inventory_item_id is reset only if the prior rollo doesn't match the new tipo, this is a subtle but correct re-selection.
CuttingView.jsx L601: selectedRollo lookup uses rollos.find(r => r.id === rolloId) — good. part-rollo-info-<id> with data-testid is present (L676).
DialogContent warning ('Missing Description or aria-describedby') appears in console — non-blocking accessibility hint from Radix; main agent may add DialogDescription if desired.
